## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run OpenThinker 7B (Q4_K_M, needs 6.4 GB memory, 4.68 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/OpenThinker-7B-GGUF/tree/091cdd601d3dc6c2c55923a965e41eb199d912ec))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf bartowski/OpenThinker-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf bartowski/OpenThinker-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (10 GB memory, 8.1 GB download) `llama cli -hf bartowski/OpenThinker-7B-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run OpenThinker 7B (Q4_K_M, needs 6.4 GB memory, 4.68 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/OpenThinker-7B-GGUF/tree/091cdd601d3dc6c2c55923a965e41eb199d912ec))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/OpenThinker-7B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (10 GB memory, 8.1 GB download) `lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/OpenThinker-7B-GGUF@Q8_0 -y` · 4bit (6 GB memory, 4.28 GB download, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/AlejandroOlmedo/OpenThinker-7B-4bit-mlx -y` · 8bit (10 GB memory, 8.09 GB download, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/AlejandroOlmedo/OpenThinker-7B-8bit-mlx -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run OpenThinker 7B (Q4_K_M, needs 6.4 GB memory, 4.68 GB download, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/openthinker/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run openthinker:7b
   ```

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run OpenThinker 7B (4bit, needs 6 GB memory, 4.28 GB download, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/AlejandroOlmedo](https://huggingface.co/AlejandroOlmedo/OpenThinker-7B-4bit-mlx/tree/2a9a5be5af1e2aeceec0db21fe9cdcd065f4dd9d))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model AlejandroOlmedo/OpenThinker-7B-4bit-mlx
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model AlejandroOlmedo/OpenThinker-7B-4bit-mlx
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (10 GB memory, 8.09 GB download, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model AlejandroOlmedo/OpenThinker-7B-8bit-mlx`
